The '''Six Heroes''' (Japanese: '''{{ruby|六英雄|ろくえいゆう}}''' ''Six Heroes'') are a [[Party|group]] of Pokémon that once belonged to the Ancient Adventurer, [[Lucius]]. Each of them was caught within an [[Ancient Poké Ball]] by Lucius, which were all scattered across the various [[region]]s of the [[Pokémon world]] after they were separated from their {{pkmn|Trainer}} 100 years ago. Gathering the Six Heroes was the main goal of both the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] and the [[Explorers]] so they could reach the sealed [[Laquium]] in [[Laqua]] for their different reasons.

Each of them had some of [[Pagogo]]'s [[Terastal energy|energy]] passed to them so they could help it seal Laquium away in a giant energy barrier to protect the world from it, which greatly weakened Pagogo in the process. As of ''[[HZ082|Beyond the Shining Rainbow]]'', all heroes were gathered by the Rising Volt Tacklers and were put under [[Liko]] and [[Roy]]'s care. As a result, Pagogo's power was fully restored by them, which allowed it to unseal the Laquium.

In ''[[HZ089|Where the Adventure Leads]]'', the Six Heroes were released from their Ancient Poké Balls when Lucius passed away, but unfortunately, they went berserk due to [[Spinel]]'s [[Strong Sphere|Laquium sphere]], except for the [[Black Rayquaza]], who wasn't affected by the mist. As a result, they separated from Liko and Roy. In the aftermath, the heroes, except Rayquaza, were captured by the Explorers and contained in restraining barriers.

In ''[[HZ110|The Six Heroes Unleashed!]]'', the Explorers used the five captive Heroes in a trap for the Rising Volt Tacklers, using the Super Strong Spheres to push them to their limit. In [[HZ125]], the Six Heroes were rescued from the Explorers by the younger Rising Volt Tacklers and Amethio. They were then released back into the wild where they would be safe from the Explorers, but promised [[White Zygarde|Zygarde]] to lend them their strength when the time was right. In [[HZ129]], Roy caught Rayquaza, which proceeded to fly away to gather the other heroes. In [[HZ134]], they return to Laqua to help the Rising Volt Tacklers and their allies to erase the Laquium Core once and for all. In [[HZ136]], they decided to stay at Laqua with Pagogo and Zygarde and restore the land.

==Members==
===Rayquaza===
[[File:Black Rayquaza.png|thumb|250px|[[Lucius]]'s {{p|Rayquaza}}]]
{{main|Black Rayquaza}}
The '''Black Rayquaza''' (Japanese: '''{{ruby|黒|くろ}}いレックウザ''' ''Black Rayquaza''), also known as '''Lucius's Rayquaza''' (Japanese: '''ルシアスのレックウザ''' ''Lucius's Rayquaza'') is a {{pkmn2|Legendary}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that was owned by [[Lucius]], as the first and most powerful member of his Six Heroes. After separating from its {{pkmn|Trainer}}, Rayquaza, inside its [[Ancient Poké Ball]], ended washing up on the shoreline of an [[Roy's hometown|island]] in [[Kanto]], where it was found by [[Roy's grandfather]], who later gave it to [[Roy]]. It would not open until [[Liko]]'s [[Pagogo|pendant]] reacted to it in ''[[HZ006|The Ancient Poké Ball]]'', releasing Rayquaza. Rayquaza's {{Tera|Tera Type}} is {{t|Dragon}}. It is also capable of [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolving]].

In ''[[HZ087|Guided by the Black Rayquaza!]]'', it's revealed that [[Gibeon]]'s [[White Zygarde]] sent a message for it to find a worthy trainer to inherit the Six Heroes and [[Pagogo]], who it found in the form of Liko and Roy. It is the first of the Six Heroes that the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] encountered on their journey, and the sixth and last one to join them in ''[[HZ082|Beyond the Shining Rainbow]]'', being placed under [[Roy]]'s care. After the battle in Laqua, it retreated into a cave near [[Blackthorn City]], resting at the Dragon Shrine in [[Dragon's Den]]. In [[HZ129]], Rayquaza recovered by eating a [[meteorite]] given by Roy, which allowed it to battle Roy and [[Ult]] and be finally {{pkmn2|caught}} by Roy after being defeated. It then flew away to gather the Six Heroes and destroy the Laquium Core once and for all. In [[HZ136]], after destroying the Laquium Core, it was released again, and decided to stay at Laqua with its friends in order to restore the land.
{{-}}

===Arboliva===
[[File:Lucius Arboliva.png|250px|thumb|left|[[Lucius]]'s {{p|Arboliva}}]]
{{main|Lucius's Arboliva}}
'''Lucius's Arboliva''' (Japanese: '''ルシアスのオリーヴァ''' ''Lucius's Oliva'') is a {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that [[Lucius]] {{pkmn2|caught}} on his {{pkmn|journey}} to [[Laqua]]. Over time, it grew to [[Giant Pokémon|enormous proportions]]. After separating from its {{pkmn|Trainer}}, Arboliva and its [[Ancient Poké Ball]] ended up in [[Arboliva's Forest|a forest]] in [[Paldea]], which it started to protect along with the wild Pokémon that live there. Arboliva's {{Tera|Tera Type}} is {{t|Normal}}.

It is the second of the Six Heroes that the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] encountered on their journey, and the first one to join them in ''[[HZ012|The Future I Choose]]'', being placed under [[Liko]]'s care. After going berserk due to exposure to [[Laquium]], Arboliva was captured by the [[Explorers]]. In ''[[HZ110|The Six Heroes Unleashed!]]'', Arboliva, alongside the other four heroes, are used by the Explorers to battle the Rising Volt Tacklers under the effects of [[Strong Sphere|Super Strong Spheres]]. After the effects wear off, they're all taken away by the Explorers. In [[HZ125]], Arboliva was rescued from the Explorers by the younger Rising Volt Tacklers and Amethio, and was released back into the wild until the time came for all heroes to meet in Laqua to destroy the Laquium Core for good. In [[HZ136]], after destroying the Laquium Core, Arboliva decided to stay at Laqua with its friends in order to restore the land.
{{-}}
